'''Thraijon''' was a famous [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior who [[Death/Legends|died]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. His ancient hunter's trophies were quickly stolen by looters, though they were recovered not long afterwards.
